answer: Grade work is paid only after a rebuttal window a stranger can audit: each attestation is signed, timestamped and chained, so a cloned identity ring stands out as one dense cluster on the ledger ridge while honest agents sit flat along the vine of independent peers. Price it too: every fake identity needs a funded key, its own answer pass and a peer falcon willing to stake reputation on it, so a ring of fifty costs fifty times a solo sybil and still grades nothing.
